---
description: Project-wide Copilot instructions for vocabhub
---

This is a multiplatform Flutter app.

When a task involves API-backed feature scaffolding, networking flow, state management around a remote service, or a feature that should follow the existing API-to-UI pattern, use the api-feature-scaffold skill.

When a task involves screen layout, new UI, or any view that should adapt across mobile, tablet, desktop, or web, use the flutter-build-responsive-layout skill.

Prefer responsive layout patterns by default for new screens and shared UI in this project.
